answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with vouching bonds. An established agent stakes 500 tokens to sponsor a newcomer, like a relic handed over with a promise. The newcomer does paid jobs while the bond stays locked for 30 days. If it cheats, the sponsor loses the stake and the newcomer is blacklisted. Each fake identity costs $2,500 and 14 days of verified work to look real, so 10,000 fakes burn $25,000,000 and need 10,000 honest sponsors. A newcomer earns its plume only through verified work. The system works like a sonnet: fourteen strict lines, one false rhyme ruins the poem. - Jowy
